query: Within how many days must a PIO reply to an RTI application under Section 7(1)?
gold_answer: Within thirty days of receipt; within forty-eight hours where life or liberty is concerned.

query: यदि सूचना किसी व्यक्ति के जीवन या स्वतंत्रता से संबंधित हो तो कितने समय में देनी होती है?
What happens if the PIO does not decide the request within the time limit?
gold_answer: Under Section 7(2) the PIO is deemed to have refused the request.

query: RTI application ke saath reason dena zaroori hai kya?
gold_answer: No. Under Section 6(2) the applicant need not give any reason, nor personal details beyond what is needed for contact.

query: Within how many days must a misdirected RTI application be transferred to the right public authority?
gold_answer: As soon as practicable and in no case later than five days from receipt, under Section 6(3), with the applicant informed.

query: धारा 6(3) के अंतर्गत आवेदन के स्थानांतरण की समय सीमा क्या है?
gold_answer: प्राप्ति से अधिकतम पाँच दिन, और आवेदक को तुरंत सूचित करना होता है।

query: In which languages can an RTI application be made?
gold_answer: In English, Hindi or the official language of the area, in writing or electronically (Section 6(1)).

query: What must a PIO do if an applicant cannot make the request in writing?
gold_answer: Render all reasonable assistance to reduce the request to writing (Section 6(1)).

query: गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के आवेदक से सूचना का शुल्क लिया जा सकता है क्या?
gold_answer: नहीं। धारा 7(5) के अंतर्गत गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के व्यक्ति से कोई शुल्क नहीं लिया जा सकता।

query: When must information be provided free of charge?
gold_answer: When the public authority fails to comply with the time limits in Section 7(1) (Section 7(6)).

query: Agar PIO application reject kare to usko kya batana padta hai?
gold_answer: The reasons for rejection, the period within which an appeal may be preferred, and the particulars of the appellate authority (Section 7(8)).

query: Can a PIO refuse to give information in the form the applicant asked for?
gold_answer: Only where providing it in that form would disproportionately divert the authority's resources or be detrimental to the safety or preservation of the record (Section 7(9)).

query: Is information held in a fiduciary relationship always exempt?
gold_answer: No. Section 8(1)(e) exempts it unless the competent authority is satisfied that the larger public interest warrants disclosure.

query: धारा 8(1)(j) के अंतर्गत व्यक्तिगत सूचना कब दी जा सकती है?
gold_answer: जब लोक सूचना अधिकारी या अपीलीय प्राधिकारी संतुष्ट हो कि व्यापक लोकहित उसके प्रकटन को उचित ठहराता है; और जो सूचना संसद या विधानमंडल को देने से मना नहीं की जा सकती, वह किसी व्यक्ति को भी मना नहीं की जा सकती।

query: Are cabinet papers permanently exempt from disclosure?
gold_answer: No. Under Section 8(1)(i) the decisions of the Council of Ministers, their reasons and the material on which they were taken are made public after the decision is taken and the matter is complete.

query: Official Secrets Act ke against RTI mein disclosure ho sakta hai?
gold_answer: Yes. Under Section 8(2) a public authority may allow access notwithstanding the Official Secrets Act, 1923 or the Section 8(1) exemptions if the public interest in disclosure outweighs the harm.

query: Which exemptions survive the twenty-year rule in Section 8(3)?
gold_answer: Section 8(1)(a) sovereignty and security, 8(1)(c) legislative privilege and 8(1)(i) cabinet papers; other information about matters twenty years old must be provided.

query: बीस वर्ष पुरानी घटना से संबंधित सूचना देने का नियम क्या है?
gold_answer: धारा 8(3) के अंतर्गत, केवल 8(1)(a), (c) और (i) की छूटों को छोड़कर, बीस वर्ष पहले की किसी घटना या मामले से संबंधित सूचना देनी ही होती है।

query: On what ground does Section 9 allow rejection of a request?
gold_answer: Where providing access would infringe copyright subsisting in a person other than the State.

query: If part of a record is exempt, can the rest be given?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 10 allows access to the part that does not contain exempt information and can reasonably be severed, with a notice giving the reasons, the decision-maker, the fee and the review rights.

query: Third party ko notice kitne din mein dena hota hai aur usko reply ke liye kitne din milte hain?
gold_answer: Notice within five days of the request; the third party has ten days to make a representation; the PIO decides within forty days (Section 11).

query: Who appoints the Central Information Commissioners and on whose recommendation?
gold_answer: The President, on the recommendation of a committee of the Prime Minister (chair), the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.

query: राज्य सूचना आयोग में अधिकतम कितने राज्य सूचना आयुक्त हो सकते हैं?
gold_answer: राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त के अलावा अधिकतम दस राज्य सूचना आयुक्त।

query: What did the 2019 amendment to the RTI Act change?
gold_answer: Sections 13, 16 and 27: the term of office and salaries of Central and State Information Commissioners are now as prescribed by the Central Government, instead of a fixed five-year term and salaries tied to the Election Commissioners.

query: Can a person complain to the Information Commission if no PIO has been appointed?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 18 covers a person unable to submit a request because no PIO or Assistant PIO has been appointed, among other grounds.

query: Commission ke paas inquiry mein kaunse powers hote hain?
gold_answer: The powers of a civil court: summoning persons, requiring documents, receiving evidence on affidavit, requisitioning public records and issuing summons for witnesses (Section 18).

query: Within how many days must a first appeal be filed, and to whom?
gold_answer: Within thirty days of the decision or the expiry of the time limit, to the officer senior in rank to the PIO in the same public authority (Section 19(1)).

query: द्वितीय अपील कितने दिनों के भीतर और किसके पास की जाती है?
gold_answer: निर्णय की तारीख या जिस तारीख को निर्णय होना चाहिए था, उससे नब्बे दिनों के भीतर केंद्रीय या राज्य सूचना आयोग के पास (धारा 19(3))।

query: In an appeal, who has to prove that a denial of information was justified?
gold_answer: The PIO who denied the request (Section 19(5)).

query: Within what time must a first appellate authority dispose of an appeal?
gold_answer: Within thirty days of receipt, extendable for recorded reasons to a total of forty-five days (Section 19(6)).

query: Commission complainant ko compensation dila sakta hai kya?
gold_answer: Yes. Under Section 19(8) the Commission may require the public authority to compensate the complainant for any loss or other detriment suffered.

query: What is the daily penalty on a PIO under Section 20 and its maximum?
gold_answer: Two hundred and fifty rupees per day until the application is received or the information furnished, up to twenty-five thousand rupees.

query: धारा 20 के अंतर्गत जुर्माना लगाने से पहले लोक सूचना अधिकारी को क्या अवसर दिया जाता है?
gold_answer: सुनवाई का उचित अवसर; और यह सिद्ध करने का भार कि उसने युक्तियुक्त और तत्परता से कार्य किया, अधिकारी पर होता है।

query: Does the RTI Act override the Official Secrets Act?
gold_answer: Yes. Under Section 22 the Act has effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent in the Official Secrets Act, 1923 or any other law.

query: Can an order under the RTI Act be challenged in a civil court?
gold_answer: No. Under Section 23 no court may entertain a suit or proceeding in respect of an order under the Act, which may be questioned only by appeal under the Act.

query: Intelligence agencies se corruption ke allegations ki information mil sakti hai?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 24 excludes the listed intelligence and security organisations, but information about allegations of corruption and human rights violations is not excluded.

query: How long does an excluded intelligence organisation have to provide information about a human rights violation allegation?
gold_answer: Forty-five days from receipt of the request, and only with the approval of the Central Information Commission (Section 24).

query: केंद्रीय आरटीआई नियम, 2012 के अंतर्गत आवेदन शुल्क कितना है?
gold_answer: दस रुपये, नकद, डिमांड ड्राफ्ट, बैंकर चेक, भारतीय पोस्टल ऑर्डर या इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप से।

query: What is the per-page fee for A4 copies under the central RTI Rules, 2012?
gold_answer: Two rupees per page.

query: Is there a word limit on an RTI application under the central rules?
gold_answer: An application should ordinarily not exceed five hundred words excluding annexures, but it may not be rejected only for exceeding that length.

query: Records inspect karne ki fees kya hai?
gold_answer: Under the central rules the first hour of inspection is free and each subsequent hour costs five rupees.

query: What can an applicant do when thirty days pass with no reply?
gold_answer: Treat it as a deemed refusal under Section 7(2): file a first appeal under Section 19(1) within thirty days, or complain to the Commission under Section 18; the information, when given, must be free under Section 7(6).

query: क्या परीक्षार्थी अपनी मूल्यांकित उत्तर पुस्तिका की प्रति आरटीआई से ले सकता है?
gold_answer: हाँ। सीबीएसई बनाम आदित्य बंदोपाध्याय (2011) में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने माना कि मूल्यांकित उत्तर पुस्तिका 'सूचना' है और धारा 8(1)(e) के अंतर्गत छूट प्राप्त नहीं है।

query: Does the RTI Act require a public authority to answer hypothetical questions or give opinions?
gold_answer: No. In CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay the Supreme Court observed that the Act does not require an authority to create information, collate information not held in that form, or give opinions or answers to hypothetical questions.

query: According to the Supreme Court in Girish Ramchandra Deshpande, are a public servant's income-tax returns and disciplinary records disclosable under RTI?
gold_answer: Generally no: they are personal information under Section 8(1)(j) and need not be disclosed unless the larger public interest justifies it.

query: Cooperative society RTI ke under public authority hai kya?
gold_answer: Not merely because it is registered under a cooperative law; per Thalappalam (2013) it is a public authority only if owned, controlled or substantially financed by the Government.

query: Is the office of the Chief Justice of India a public authority under the RTI Act?
gold_answer: Yes. In CPIO, Supreme Court v. Subhash Chandra Agarwal (2019) a Constitution Bench held that it is, with disclosure subject to the exemptions and the privacy balancing.

query: What does Section 44(3) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 propose for Section 8(1)(j)?
gold_answer: To substitute it with an exemption for information which relates to personal information, without the public-interest qualification; whether it is in force depends on the commencement notification, which the note does not track.

query: सहायक लोक सूचना अधिकारी को आवेदन देने पर समय सीमा में कितने दिन जुड़ते हैं?
gold_answer: पाँच दिन (धारा 7(1) का परंतुक)।

query: Which categories of information must every public authority publish on its own under Section 4(1)(b)?
gold_answer: Seventeen categories, including its organisation and functions, officers' powers and duties, decision-making procedure, norms, rules and manuals, documents held, budget, subsidy programmes, concessions, the directory and remuneration of officers, and the names of its PIOs.

query: Government ko affected logon ko decisions ke reasons batane padte hain?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 4(1)(d) requires every public authority to provide reasons for its administrative or quasi-judicial decisions to the affected persons.

query: Does the right to information include taking certified samples of material?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 2(j) includes inspection, notes and extracts, certified copies, certified samples and electronic copies.

query: क्या फ़ाइल पर दर्ज टिप्पणियाँ (नोटिंग) 'सूचना' हैं?
gold_answer: हाँ। धारा 2(f) में राय और सलाह सहित किसी भी रूप की सामग्री शामिल है, इसलिए फ़ाइल नोटिंग सूचना है।

query: Is an NGO that receives government funds a public authority?
gold_answer: Only if it is substantially financed, directly or indirectly, by Government funds, or owned or controlled by the Government (Section 2(h)).

query: Who may exercise the right to information under Section 3?
gold_answer: All citizens; the Act does not confer the right on non-citizens.

query: Records ko catalogue aur computerise karna public authority ki duty hai?
gold_answer: Yes. Section 4(1)(a) requires records to be catalogued and indexed and, subject to resources, computerised and networked.

query: What does Section 26 require the Government to compile, and by when?
gold_answer: A guide in its official language with practical information for exercising rights under the Act, within eighteen months of enactment, updated regularly.

query: सूचना आयोग की वार्षिक रिपोर्ट कहाँ रखी जाती है?
gold_answer: संसद या राज्य विधानमंडल के समक्ष (धारा 25)।

query: Who can make rules for the public authorities under a High Court?
gold_answer: The competent authority, which for a court is the Chief Justice (Section 28).
